dz: 瓦西里·阿基波夫拒绝同意向美国军舰发射核鱼雷,从而避免了核战争.
de: By refusing to agree to the firing of a nuclear torpedo at a US warship, Vasily Arkhipov averts nuclear war.

t: 美国空军少校鲁道夫·安德森 (Rudolf Anderson) 的 U-2 侦察机在古巴上空被…
te: Major Rudolf Anderson of the United States Air Force becomes the only direct human casualty of the Cuban Missile Crisis…
dz: 美国空军少校鲁道夫·安德森 (Rudolf Anderson) 的 U-2 侦察机在古巴上空被苏联提供的地对空导弹击落，成为古巴导弹危机中唯一的直接人员伤亡。
de: Major Rudolf Anderson of the United States Air Force becomes the only direct human casualty of the Cuban Missile Crisis when his U-2 reconnaissance airplane is shot down over Cuba by a Soviet-supplied surface-to-air missile.

t: 古巴导弹危机结束，总理尼基塔·赫鲁晓夫下令从古巴撤走苏联导弹。
te: The Cuban Missile Crisis ends and Premier Nikita Khrushchev orders the removal of Soviet missiles from Cuba.
dz: 古巴导弹危机结束，总理尼基塔·赫鲁晓夫下令从古巴撤走苏联导弹。
de: The Cuban Missile Crisis ends and Premier Nikita Khrushchev orders the removal of Soviet missiles from Cuba.

te: The United States concludes Operation Fishbowl, its final above-ground nuclear weapons testing series, in anticipation …
dz: 美国结束了“鱼缸行动”，这是其最后的地面核武器试验系列，以迎接 1963 年《部分禁止核试验条约》的签署。
de: The United States concludes Operation Fishbowl, its final above-ground nuclear weapons testing series, in anticipation of the 1963 Partial Nuclear Test Ban Treaty.

de: Cuban Missile Crisis ends: In response to the Soviet Union agreeing to remove its missiles from Cuba, U.S. President John F. Kennedy ends the quarantine of the Caribbean nation.
